thick atmospheric haze — dense particulate suspending light into visible volumetric beams, distance fades into gradient
wind-driven dust haze — orange or amber dust streaming horizontally across the frame, sand-grain texture in the air
acid-rain fog — corrosive humid mist clinging to surfaces, vapor visible at ground level, oxidized streaks on materials
vapor streams from vents — geothermal or mechanical steam plumes rising at multiple points, catching light from below
clear cold air — no haze, infinite visibility, sharp detail at all depths, brittle precision
ash drift — fine dark particulate falling slowly through the frame, accumulating on horizontal surfaces, sky overcast
snow flurry — flakes drifting across the frame, partial visibility, white speckle texture against dark structures
ionized atmosphere — air charged with visible electrical micro-discharge, faint blue glow at sharp edges, hair-raising static energy
nebula gas wisps — magenta-and-cyan cloud edges drifting across the frame, soft volumetric tendrils glowing from within
cosmic dust haze — fine particulate scattering distant starlight, diffusing horizon edges, subtle pinpoint reflections
ion engine plasma cloud — turbulent blue-white plume trailing behind ships, ionized vapor expanding outward
micrometeorite spray — high-velocity particle stream lit by impact sparks against hulls, frozen at instant of strike
debris field drift — slow-tumbling hull fragments and metallic shards spreading across mid-distance, edges catching light
solar flare particle stream — radiant plasma ribbons curling outward from a distant star, ionized matter in slow-motion bloom
ice crystal cloud — frozen vapor sublimating in vacuum, prismatic sparkle catching starlight as a faint shimmering haze
magnetic-field shimmer — visible auroral curtains rippling across the upper atmosphere, faint colored bands stretching to horizon
radiation auroral haze — diffuse colored glow emanating from a nearby high-energy source, soft tinted halo enveloping the scene
jump-drive Cherenkov afterglow — fading blue-white radiation pattern marking a recent FTL exit, dispersing into vacuum
comet sublimation trail — ice-and-dust streamers fanning out from a passing comet, lit by distant sun-flare
coolant vapor venting — pressurized cryogenic clouds bursting from ship vents, freezing instantly into expanding white plumes
plasma exhaust glow — hot engine wake illuminating the volume around drives, pulsing in rhythmic thrust bursts
electromagnetic distortion — wavefront ripples warping starlight, visible as faint lensing eddies across the frame
tachyon shockwave — expanding spherical pulse of energy from a distant detonation, lighting nearby particulate
oxygen-vent burst — pressurized atmosphere jetting from hull breach, freezing into a crystalline white cloud
thermal radiator bloom — heat-shimmer waves emanating from extended radiator panels, visible as warped vacuum bands
asteroid pulverized dust — rock fragments and powder spreading after a mining strike or impact, slowly settling
fusion drive exhaust — bright white plasma flame trailing from a maneuvering capital ship, casting backlight on debris
neutron star aurora — eerie violet-green particle storm raining from a magnetar overhead, particles spiraling along field lines
gas giant atmospheric shear — high-altitude wind layers visible as banded turbulence with lightning flashes deep below
antimatter annihilation flicker — tiny blue-white sparkles dotting the void where matter and antimatter collide
